audit.why: Viktor owns early (Ekko must enter E range to farm), 6 is a skill window (Chronobreak vs Gravity Field), Ekko spikes at first item + R, Viktor retakes at two items. Content layer and packet chart agree; 49.59% over 3666 games fits TRICKY.
Spikes correctly placed at 3-5 Viktor, 6 skill, first item Ekko, two items Viktor.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Death Ray' for Viktor E (really Hextech Ray) in spikes[0]. Full-layer level chart contradicted the content layer on 6 of 7 rows. breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers. Missing interactions never stated: Chronobreak untargetability + heal (don't spend final damage into it — partially present), Phase Dive is an auto-reset whose wind-up is the step-back tell, Phase Dive's short 325 roll range vs your wave positioning.
audit.why: Kit: Ekko R 110/80/50 untargetable + heals; E 9s CD, 325 range, autoReset flag; W 22s with hardCC stun zone. 'Use Chronobreak' in wants.foe[2] is a suspectNames false positive — correct ability name, left alone.
audit.corrected: Name fixed, chart aligned with whys rewritten, cooldowns numbered, dive-range and low-HP-execute interactions written into dos/donts bodies.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chronobreak window had no number; his W stun downtime never quantified.
audit.why: R 110s rank 1 falling to 50s; W 22s early.

edits.before: Ekko wins by landing Chronobreak, denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Ekko wins by landing Parallel Convergence stun into Phase Dive, then rewinding whatever you answered with Chronobreak.

edits.before: - Ekko Chronobreak: matchup-defining — Erases your kill and bursts back — track the hologram and save final damage for after it. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Gravity Field has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Chronobreak: 110s at rank 1, 50s at max — erases your kill and heals him; save final damage for after it. - His W Parallel Convergence is 22s early: once the stun zone is spent he has no lockup for twenty-plus seconds. - Your W is 17s; his E roll only 9s.

edits.before: E through the wave into his chest, Q-shield the response, empowered-auto, and walk — a full trade where his answer hit a shield.
edits.after: His Phase Dive is only 325 range — lasering from behind the wave forces him to roll through minions before he can blink onto you.

edits.before: Casting E at melee-adjacent range against a loaded engage — Viktor's cast times are an assassin's favorite metronome.
edits.after: His W deals bonus damage to low-health targets on-hit — at half HP the roll-blink combo deletes you before your W comes back.

edits.before: Q-shield trades on his last-hits — the empowered auto walk-away is sneakily one of the better level-1 trades mid.
edits.after: He steps into range to farm and stack his passive — Q-shield plus empowered auto wins level 1 before his ult exists.

edits.before: E online: the laser farms AND pokes in one cast. Aim it through minions into his chest on every wave contact.
edits.after: E online: the laser farms AND pokes in one cast — he must commit to a CS to trade back, and he eats it each time.

edits.before: Full kit: W zones his aggression and the E-Q-auto trade pattern is fully armed. Stack your first augment quietly.
edits.after: Full kit: W zones his roll-in, and with E max shoving he cannot out-trade you before Chronobreak exists — yours.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — laser every wave contact and bank Manaflow. Each augment makes the same spells quietly crueler.
edits.after: Through 4-5 you shove and out-trade him before he has an ult — Lost Chapter funds a laser on every wave contact.

edits.before: Chaos Storm online — your all-in answer and teamfight entry. In lane it's the kill: W-E-R on anyone who oversteps.
edits.after: Chronobreak lets him dive and rewind, but Gravity Field stuns the roll-in — a skill window on who commits first.

edits.before: Luden's spike: the laser chunks a third bar and the storm executes the remainder. Force extended rotations.
edits.after: First item plus R makes him the bully: W stun, E in, combo, rewind out — respect it until his R shows down.

edits.before: Evolved late-game Viktor is a zone the enemy can't enter: W the choke, E the clump, and steer R through the retreat.
edits.after: Two items retake it: his short combo eats a W stun inside your zone, and he burns Chronobreak to live, not to kill.

edits.before: You out-lane him here. Ekko's Q (Timewinder) poke is real but he has to step into your E (Death Ray) range to farm and land his slow, and you win the extended trade with your shield up. Push the wave and force him to CS under threat before he has ult to reset mistakes.
edits.after: You out-lane him here. Ekko's Q (Timewinder) poke is real but he has to step into your E (Hextech Ray) range to farm and land his slow, and you win the extended trade with your shield up. Push the wave and force him to CS under threat before he has ult to reset mistakes.
